features.title: Kluczowe funkcje
features.desc: Wszystko czego potrzebujesz do automatyzacji workflow

f1.title: 400+ Integrations
f1.desc: Connect Gmail, Slack, Telegram, Google Sheets, Notion, MySQL, PostgreSQL, REST API and hundreds more.

f2.title: Visual Drag & Drop
f2.desc: Intuitive visual editor, no code needed. Design complex workflows with simple drag-and-drop.

f3.title: Diverse Triggers
f3.desc: Trigger by Webhook, Cron, email events, Telegram messages, database changes, and many more.

f4.title: Self-hosted & Secure
f4.desc: Deploy on-premise, full data control. HTTPS, secure cookies, MFA, SAML, LDAP, OIDC support.

f5.title: Custom Code & AI

f6.title: Monitoring & Management
f6.desc: Detailed execution logs, in-editor debugging, version control, audit logs, and insights dashboard.

s1.title: Login / Sign Up
s1.desc: Visit n8n.vnso.vn, login with email or create a new account.

s2.title: Create New Workflow
s2.desc: Press Ctrl+Alt+N or click 'Add workflow'. Give it a descriptive name.

s3.title: Add Trigger Node
s3.desc: Choose a trigger: Webhook, Schedule, Email, Telegram... First node is always a trigger.

s4.title: Connect Action Nodes
s4.desc: Drag-and-drop processing nodes: send email, call API, process data. Connect with wires.

s5.title: Test & Debug
s5.desc: Click 'Test workflow' to run. View output per node, debug in editor.

s6.title: Activate & Monitor
s6.desc: Toggle 'Active' to run automatically. Monitor in Executions tab.

api.title: REST API & Webhook
api.desc: Integrate with any system via API
